name: inkprompts-journal
description: A private, encrypted daily journal that stays on your device.
author: Chao Wang <hello@inkprompts.com>

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests build/after-pack.cjs build/check-public-release-urls.mjs build/generate-third-party-notices.mjs build/package-contents.cjs build/package-development.mjs build/prepare-electron-licenses.mjs build/redistributed-package-audit.mjs build/third-party-components.json electron.vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs package.json electron-builder.yml README.md OPEN_SOURCE_NOTICES.md ASSETS-LICENSE.md .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests build/after-pack.cjs build/check-public-release-urls.mjs build/generate-third-party-notices.mjs build/package-contents.cjs build/package-development.mjs build/prepare-electron-licenses.mjs build/redistributed-package-audit.mjs build/third-party-components.json electron.vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs package.json electron-builder.yml README.md OPEN_SOURCE_NOTICES.md ASSETS-LICENSE.md .github
scripts.lint: eslint --cache src tests electron.vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run license:check:generated && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.license:generate: npm run prepare:electron-licenses && npm run build && node build/generate-third-party-notices.mjs
scripts.license:check: npm run prepare:electron-licenses && npm run build && npm run license:check:generated
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.build:unpack: npm run prepare:electron-licenses && npm run build && npm run license:check:generated && node build/package-development.mjs --dir
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare:electron-licenses && npm run build && npm run license:check:generated && node build/package-development.mjs --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:electron-licenses && npm run build && npm run license:check:generated && node build/package-development.mjs --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run prepare:electron-licenses && npm run build && npm run license:check:generated && node build/package-development.mjs --linux
